description: Implement SportScore football data provider following existing provider architecture pattern. Create SportScoreFootballProvider class in backend/app/providers/sportscore.py inheriting from FootballDataProvider. Implement methods for live matches, match detail, events, lineups, and live match state. Add provider configuration to backend/app/config.py. Integrate with ProviderManager. Write comprehensive tests.
steps: Read backend/app/providers/base.py to understand FootballDataProvider interface (required methods, abstract methods, method signatures)

Read backend/app/providers/ryzellx.py and backend/app/providers/fotmob.py to study existing provider implementation patterns (httpx.AsyncClient usage, error handling, cache integration, retry logic, response normalization)
Read backend/app/providers/models.py to understand ProviderMatch, ProviderLiveMatch, ProviderMatchEvent, ProviderLineup, ProviderMatchStats schemas
Read backend/app/providers/exceptions.py for ProviderError, ProviderTimeoutError, ProviderHTTPError, ProviderNotFoundError
Read backend/app/providers/cache.py for ProviderCache usage (get/set with TTL)
Create backend/app/providers/sportscore.py: Implement SportScoreFootballProvider class with __init__(base_url, timeout_seconds, retry_count, cache), async close(), _request() method with retry logic
Implement get_live_matches() → GET /api/1/events?status=live, parse response, return List[ProviderLiveMatch] with provider='sportscore', is_live=True, fetched_at=now
Implement get_match(match_id) → GET /api/1/events/{match_id}, parse response, return ProviderMatch with all available fields (teams, scores, status, competition), use None for unavailable fields
Implement get_match_events(match_id) → parse events from match detail response, return List[ProviderMatchEvent] with type mapping (GOAL, YELLOW_CARD, RED_CARD, SUBSTITUTION, VAR_DECISION)
Implement get_match_lineups(match_id) → parse lineups from match detail response, return List[ProviderLineup] with formation, starting_xi, substitutes
Implement get_live_match_state(match_id) → NEW method (not in base interface yet), return Optional[LiveMatchState] from backend/app/domain/live.py with provider='sportscore', data_quality flags
Add to backend/app/config.py: sportscore_enabled: bool = True, sportscore_base_url: str = 'https://sportscore.com', sportscore_api_key: Optional[str] = None
Update backend/app/providers/manager.py (if exists) or create integration point to add SportScore provider to available providers list

Create backend/tests/providers/test_sportscore.py: Test get_live_matches with mocked HTTP responses, test get_match, test get_match_events, test error handling (timeout, 404, invalid JSON), test cache behavior
Run backend tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/providers/test_sportscore.py -v, fix any failures
Manually test provider: Create test script backend/test_sportscore_manual.py that instantiates provider and calls get_live_matches(), run it, verify it handles real API responses or errors gracefully
Commit: 'feat(providers): add SportScore football data provider with live match support'
acceptance_criteria: All required FootballDataProvider methods implemented (get_provider_name, is_development_data, get_matches, get_match, get_match_events, get_match_lineups)
Provider uses httpx.AsyncClient with timeout and retry logic following existing patterns
Provider integrates with ProviderCache (30-second TTL for live data)
backend/app/config.py includes sportscore_enabled, sportscore_base_url, sportscore_api_key fields
backend/tests/providers/test_sportscore.py created with at least 5 test cases covering happy path and error scenarios
All provider tests pass: pytest tests/providers/test_sportscore.py returns 0 exit code
Provider normalizes SportScore responses to ProviderLiveMatch, ProviderMatch, ProviderMatchEvent, ProviderLineup models
Provider uses None for unavailable fields (never fabricates data)
Provider raises ProviderError on failures (never returns fabricated data on error)
verification: All tests pass (exit code 0, no failures)
